subject: Inbound: Redwood demo + security sync — coordinating AE/SE/IT across time zones

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@soliduslabs.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-05T08:12:00Z
Subject: Interest: Redwood demo + security sync

Hi Nikhil,

We signed up via the self-serve flow and I wanted to follow up directly. We're evaluating Redwood for inference serving across a few teams. Our evaluation will need: a short product demo for stakeholders (AE + SE presence), and a deeper session with our IT/security folks to go over SSO and data handling.

Quick context: Solidus Labs is running trials across EU and US teams; I'm based in Dublin (GMT+1). Our security team prefers a separate 45–60 min call just for SSO, SOC 2 artifact Q&A, and network egress questions. I've attached our high-level security checklist (security_requirements.pdf).

Preferred windows this week: mornings Dublin time (09:00–11:00) or late afternoons PST (15:00–17:00) if that helps align with your US folks. Can you propose 2 options — one for the stakeholder demo (30 min) and one for the security deep-dive?

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director, Platform Engineering
Solidus Labs
liam.oconnor@soliduslabs.com

Attachment: security_requirements.pdf

Thanks for the note and the checklist, Liam — really helpful. Looping in Karthik (AE) and Olga (SE) so we can propose times and scope the two sessions.

Plan suggestion:
- 30 min product walkthrough (Karthik + Olga) — high-level flow, performance profile, hosting options
- 45 min security deep-dive (Olga + our Security Engineering liaison) — SSO, SOC 2 artifacts, network/egress, data retention and private deployment options

Proposed slots (I tried to give one EU-morning and one US-afternoon option):
1) Tue May 11 — 09:30–10:00 Dublin / 01:30–02:00 PDT (product walkthrough)
2) Tue May 11 — 16:00–16:45 Dublin / 08:00–08:45 PDT (security deep-dive)
3) Wed May 12 — 10:00–10:30 Dublin / 02:00–02:30 PDT (alternate product slot)

If those don't work, tell us your best windows and we'll send calendar invites. Also — who should we include from your IT/security team? You can forward their email or add them on reply.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
SDR | Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
